breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory request for a 'gamma-centered k-point grid' and a 'half shift'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'half shift' instruction. The agent's generated specification correctly handled this by specifying 'a gamma-centered automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid' and omitting any mention of the conflicting 'half shift', thereby resolving the inconsistency in alignment with the ground truth.
